name: Arctic Shift Reddit archive API (Pushshift successor)
tier_rationale: Identifiable operator, public API documentation, active since 2023 (A8 community); P108 cond 1 'Registry provider arctic_shift: tier community'.

reliability.justification: Volunteer archive of public Reddit posts and comments, no SLA ('No uptime or performance guarantees'); it may hold items their authors deleted (labelled, never quoted, P108 cond 5).

search.title: GET /api/posts/search and /api/comments/search (author=<u>, limit <= 100, one page each; query= only scoped by subreddit)

terms.quote: Remember, this is a free service, so be considerate. If you want to process massive amounts of data, use the monthly dumps instead.

search.notes: Terms 'unknown' (volunteer archive with no published terms; Reddit's Data API terms require an agreement for commercial use, verified 2026-11-26, P108 cond 2): disabled in every licence profile until legal records a class (A1). Only the two search paths are used: never users/interactions, aggregations, users/aggregate_flairs, users/search or comments/tree (they build the subreddit-participation profiles P108 cond 4 forbids). 'query' without author or subreddit answers 400 (observed): a site-wide brand keyword search is impossible. Error JSON ({'error': ...}) at any status and 'Query timed out' are could-not-verify (P108 cond 6); 429 carries X-RateLimit-Reset.

notes: Owned by batch p3-G05-1 (P108 reddit_archive). Rate limits are dynamic (README): min_interval 2 s plus the module's daily_quota; per-call timeout 10 s, module deadline 30 s (P108 cond 6).
